source: PKLot (Almeida et al., Expert Systems with Applications 42(11), 2015, doi:10.1016/j.eswa.2015.02.009), CC BY 4.0, via https://huggingface.co/datasets/Voxel51/PKLot
detector: YOLO26m (Ultralytics, AGPL-3.0), whole frame plus 3 x 3 tiles at 960 px, conf 0.05; a space is taken when one car, bus or truck box covers 40% of it; it changes state when two frames in a row agree

whole.text: the rest of the car park, outside the hand-labelled spaces: a space is wherever a vehicle box (confidence 0.15 or more; the far rows also on 5 x 5 tiles enlarged 3 times) stays in one place, IoU 0.35 with itself, on 4 frames or more (20 minutes); it is taken when a box with confidence 0.1 or more overlaps it with IoU 0.25, and changes state when two frames in a row agree

eval.forecastText: spaces taken h minutes ahead: taken now plus h times the mean of the last 20 minutes' slope and the typical-day slope of the same car park (PKLot labels of its other weekdays); checked against the hand labels of the frame h minutes later; naive: as many as now
